caption: The drawing features a single object centered on a plain, lightly textured beige background. The object resembles a scoop or shovel, composed primarily of shades of brown. The scoop is cylindrical with an open top and has slightly angled, rounded ends. Attached to its middle section is a curved handle that arches upward and is affixed by visible rivets or bolts at both ends. There is an additional, shorter grip handle that protrudes from the side, also attached with rivets. The handle and grip are both the same brown color as the scoop, with subtle shading indicating their metallic texture. There are no other objects or elements in the drawing, and the artist’s signature, "LeRoy Griffith", is located in the bottom right corner.
title: Grain Scoop
